prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1377; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in the sideswipe collision that occurred while your insured was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. Any statements, requests for information, or settlement discussions should be routed through counsel.

Please provide the complete liability policy declarations page for the insured identified in your claim file, including the bodily injury and property damage limits in force at the time of the loss. We also request written confirmation of any other policies that may apply, such as umbrella or excess coverage.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle inspection and repair records, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of these materials while the claim is open.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
